cues.text: Her mask glows red.
Purple light erupts around Metis, axe in hand.
Shards swirl around her like wings.
Metis swings. Aigis is thrown against the wall.
Mitsuru, Junpei and Ken look on.
Aigis winces, one eye shut.
Metis turns toward Ken.
Junpei and Koromaru charge.
They all rush at Metis.
In white light, the hero stands with his back turned.
Blue light bursts from Aigis's chest.
The light floods the lounge.
A helmeted face shatters.
Aigis spreads her arms in a column of blue light.
A new figure takes shape around her.
White hair, one glowing red eye, a pink scarf.
Aigis stands calm beside her new Persona.
Ken huddles on the floor. Aigis faces Metis.
Her Persona draws back its fist.
It strikes Metis.
Lightning crackles over her.
Metis staggers.
She stands in the rubble.
Sparks crawl over her armor.
The glow in her mask fades.
Her mask opens.
Beneath it, a girl's face with red eyes.
Aigis's eyes dim to grey.
Junpei and Mitsuru stand in the wreckage.
